name: konoha
description: A squad of Konoha ninja (reusable subagents) that power four dev-workflow skills: /scroll (draft an issue), /mission (ticket to Draft PR), /debrief (resolve the reviews on your PR), and /exam (review a colleague's PR). Since 0.3.0 Codex (newest GPT) is the decision maker — it authors the plan and rules on contested findings — and Claude executes. 0.4.0 added Kurenai, the illusion-dispel AI-output lens (hallucinated APIs + slop); 0.5.0 added two-dial mission tiering (difficulty × risk), the ANBU failure-path lens, and the delta close; 0.6.0 makes /exam verify every finding against the merge base and classify it by provenance, so a review carries only what the PR introduced — pre-existing and codebase-wide findings are handed back as a separate follow-up list instead of growing the diff. Inspired by thk, but where thk has one entrypoint, konoha shares one cast across four skills. Naruto-themed skin over a neutral engine.
